items.title: Mrs. Francis Oliver Interview, 1969-05-10
items.q: Well, I saw him again. He was sick.

ctx.x: Well, do you remember seeing your brother then any other time after, say, around 1906, when he was six years old, until you went and she called him?
25, 1925 or nothing. Well, I saw him again. He was sick.
Your sister tells about that the only time she really heard him play, he came here in 1918. Now, you would have been 18 years old then. I don't remember him.
